question: Where was the World Sustainable Development Summit (WSDS) held in March 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**New Delhi, India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **World Sustainable Development Summit (WSDS)** is an annual flagship event organized by the **Energy and Resources Institute (TERI).**
 
• The summit focuses on **sustainability concerns, climate change, and environmental issues** to promote global cooperation.
 
• In **March 2025**, the WSDS was held in **New Delhi, India**, which is known for hosting several high-profile international events related to **climate and sustainable development.**
